breaking.change: Every game shader now has `hg_phase(cos_t, g)` (the Henyey-Greenstein phase function) in scope, and lit material shaders `range_window(light, d2)` and `spot_cone(light, l)` (a local light's windowed falloff and a spot's cone), from the engine's one copy; a shader that declares one of these names no longer compiles.
breaking.fix: Delete your own copy and call the library's, or rename yours.

added.summary: A game shader may scatter light by the Henyey-Greenstein phase function, and a lit one fade a local light to its range and a spot to its cone as the engine's lights do.
